text:
Predicates:
Timeless(x) ::: x is timeless.
MassProduct(x) ::: x is a mass product design.
DesignStyle(x) ::: x is a design style.
Evocative(x) ::: x is evocative.
Dreamy(x) ::: x is dreamy.
DesignBy(x, y) ::: x is a design by y.
Premises:
∀x (DesignStyle(x) → Timeless(x)) ::: All of Zaha Hadid's design styles are timeless.
∀x (MassProduct(x) → ¬Timeless(x)) ::: No mass product design is timeless.
DesignStyle(zaha) ∨ DesignStyle(kelly) ::: Either Zaha Hadid's design style or Kelly Wearstler's design style.
∀x (DesignBy(x, kelly) → Evocative(x)) ::: All of Kelly Wearstler's design styles are evocative.
∀x (DesignBy(x, kelly) → Dreamy(x)) ::: All of Kelly Wearstler's design styles are dreamy.
∀x (Timeless(DesignBy(x, max)) → (MassProduct(DesignBy(x, max)) ∧ Evocative(DesignBy(x, max)))) ::: If a design by Max is timeless, then a design by Max is a mass product design and evocative.
Conclusion:
Evocative(DesignBy(max, max)) ∨ Dreamy(DesignBy(max, max)) ::: A design by Max is either evocative or dreamy.
